LanguageData.HD_CaravanLoss_Explanation: Records player attacks on visiting LOW/HIGH caravans only. Values use silver market prices. Injuries are assessed from the pawn's pre-attack value and health-percentage loss. Death records the remaining pawn value after recorded injuries. Dropped items are recorded separately. This ledger is independent of goodwill penalties, loans and compensation obligations; it does not automatically charge anything.
